title: Blue Armored Catgirl Triptych
description: A three-panel artwork displays the same female character with short silver hair, blue armored outfit, and a long blue tail in three distinct dynamic poses against a solid pink background. Left panel shows her crouching low, middle panel captures her mid-jump with one leg raised, right panel shows her in a confident standing pose with dust swirling at her feet.
prompt: A triptych of a fierce female character with short layered silver hair and bright blue eyes, wearing a form-fitting blue armored bodysuit with large shoulder pauldrons, matching blue boots and gloves, and a long flexible blue tail. She is shown in three poses: crouching low on the left, jumping dynamically in the center, and standing powerfully on the right with dust at her feet. Vibrant hot pink background, digital painting style with smooth shading and strong highlights.
